row.body: A hand shovel rests across a wash pail, both striped with yellow dust. The pail smells of crop spray; road tape is knotted through its handle.
row.title: Field dust on the wash pail

sidecar.gloss: A personal trace links trial residue to illness before a later restriction.
sidecar.rival_reading: A response team could have carried farm supplies while checking exposure; the objects and timing do not establish that the trial caused it.

row.body: The radio dial is bound with a narrow strip of tape. Its battery has been replaced recently, although the callers barricaded here had no way to send a reply. Someone wanted them listening to one channel.
row.title: Frequency held through the siege

sidecar.gloss: A receiver was maintained during a siege but could not be used to answer.
sidecar.rival_reading: The same frequency might have carried warnings about a field treatment, not instructions to control the people inside.
